get.description: Fields with a `null` or otherwise empty value will not be included in the response at all, even if they are included in the `fields` parameter. Only allowed for operators, for SSP users use /requester/visitors instead.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description:
A FIQL search expression to filter the result. The FIQL query syntax is documented in the tutorial.

The fields available for filtering are:
  • All top-level fields in the returned dto, and the visitor, visit and host sub-dtos. Additionally, you can filter by archived, which is a boolean, and by arrivalStatus, which can be either 'expected', 'arrived', 'departed' or 'cancelled'.
  • For visitor.phoneNumber, host.phoneNumber and host.mobileNumber, a special =phone= operator is available. This operator ignores dashes and spaces in both the query and the database, and performs an 'ends with' check.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: The fields to include in the returned object(s). Sub-objects can be included as a whole ('visitor') or per sub-field ('visitor.name'). All fields defined in the GET single endpoint can be added here, and are relative to the 'results' property. One additional property 'total' can be included, which will add a field to the parent object (next to 'results') with the total count of visitors after applying any relevant filters. If you want the arrivalStatus displayed, you can add 'visit.arrivalStatus' in the fields. In that case, the whole visit object will be returned.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: The order in which to return in the object(s). Supports all field types except id and arrivalStatus.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The number of visitors to return. Max 1.000.000. Please request only data you really need (via the fields parameter) when querying large numbers of visitors.

post.description: Creates one or more visitor cards by specifying persons and visits. A visitor card is created for each combination of person and visit. Only available for operators. For SSP Users, use /requester/visitors instead.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: The `host` field supports most features from the caller block in the UI: You can specify either a person or an unregistered caller name. It is an error to specify both or neither. When specifying an unregistered caller, the branch field becomes mandatory. You can supply custom values for all other fields. If you don't, those values will be taken from the person or branch. When updating a caller block, all unspecified values will be taken from the new person and/or branch. If you want to keep the current values instead, explicitly specify them along with your update. This also means that if you want to change only the email field, you will have to specify the current values for all other fields, or they will be changed back to the value from the person or branch.

200.description: Visitors created successfully. Only returns id and number for created visitors.
